summary: Observed associations from Gold admissions (descriptive, not causal). Unplanned readmissions only.
findings: 'Elective' admissions have the highest observed unplanned 30-day readmission rate (1.5%, n=5542).
Highest-rate admitting reason: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual (procedure) (7.2% of 139 stays).
Planned same-reason repeat stays (e.g. chemotherapy cycles) and transfers are excluded from these rates.
